entries.140f59b4eb01b27a: This business model manufactures in-house bearings, hydraulic equipment and other components, as well as machine tools such as tools, machine tools and robots, and sells them through domestic and overseas manufacturing companies, including automakers, and sales companies.
entries.1b3edef821fc1554: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥235,903 million, down 1.7% from the prior year. This was due to the effects of a review of capital investment plans in China and weak domestic demand in the construction machinery field. By business, the components business was ¥147,255 million, the machine tools business ¥73,407 million, and other businesses ¥15,240 million.
entries.1bd8f210ce92fded: This business manufactures and sells specialty steel and provides transportation and information processing-related services; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥15,240 million. Demand for specialty steel decreased, mainly in Japan. In transportation, consolidated subsidiary Nachi Logistics Co., Ltd. is responsible for transporting the company's products.
entries.2ec4dbd3e174fea9: This business manufactures and sells bearings and hydraulic equipment, with revenue from external customers of ¥147,255 million for the fiscal year ended November 2025, the largest of the three reportable segments. In the automotive field, demand for car hydraulics (hydraulic equipment for automobiles) increased due to a recovery in production at some manufacturers, while in the construction machinery field, demand for hydraulic equipment declined due to domestic production adjustments.
entries.3556c8222e478fa8: Its management philosophy cites “manufacturing technology that the world can be proud of,” and it regards raising corporate value as its most important issue. Its business operating policy over the medium to long term is to develop robots into the core of the company, and as a milestone of its long-term vision it sets an overseas revenue ratio of 60% through expansion of overseas business. Going forward, it plans to leverage its distinctiveness as a general machinery manufacturer, place robots at the core of business growth, and provide high value-added manufacturing and solutions.

entries.576e4017d0d37ab8: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥5,250 million, up 56.7% from the prior year. It is pursuing structural reform across its businesses, including optimizing facilities and personnel, rationalization covering all departments, and expanding in-house production, and is also working to pass on increases in raw material prices to selling prices.

entries.6057bbf0e1fe360a: Its strength lies in its character as a general machinery manufacturer that combines, with robots at its core, cutting tools, machine tools, bearings, hydraulic equipment and the specialty steel business. It has an integrated production flow from materials to products, dating from the establishment of a steelworks in 1938, and in addition to its production base in Toyama, it has built a network of manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in the Americas, Europe and Asia.
entries.69ec45322c458cab: This business manufactures and sells tools, machine tools and robots. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥73,407 million.
entries.847812713413974a: The company consists of the company, 51 subsidiaries and two affiliates (as of November 30, 2025). Consolidated employees number 6,532 (fiscal year ended November 2025). Its registered head office is in Minato-ku, Tokyo, and it has its main production base in Toyama, Toyama Prefecture, its place of founding.

entries.b56ca7bae533eb10: In Japan, the company itself mainly handles sales to large-volume customers such as automakers, and sales to small- and medium-volume customers and through the aftermarket channel, and sells to customers in specific regions and fields through domestic sales companies. Overseas, sales are made through local sales subsidiaries and others. The major customer is Okaya & Co., Ltd., and revenue from it for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥30,372 million (12.9% of consolidated revenue).

entries.f7d8ef27a2d01e1b: This business manufactures and sells tools, machine tools and robots. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥73,407 million. Demand for tools increased in North America, while it was affected by a decline in demand for robots in China.
entries.fcf2375a5a52830c: As a general machinery manufacturer with robots at its core, handling components such as bearings and hydraulic equipment, machine tools such as tools and machine tools, and even specialty steel, it develops new products and makes technical proposals that contribute to customers' manufacturing. Part of its manufacturing is outsourced to affiliates in Japan and overseas.
